text:
alex: pinging support — customer TidalApps reporting intermittent 502/504s on POST /v1/generate (streaming) since ~08:10 UTC. p95 has spiked from ~200ms to ~1.4s, multiple customers impacted briefly. Customer reports their app enters an SDK retry loop and sees duplicate billing hits.

maria: @alex thanks. can you grab a trace_id, the exact request (sanitized), region, model, and SDK version? any recent infra changes in ingress?

alex: provided to customer and paste here (sanitized):
alex: ```
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>" -H "Accept: text/event-stream" -d '{"model":"redwood-ax-16k","input":"<trimmed>"}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
```
alex: trace_id=tidal-2026-03-17-08:12:43 (trc_abc123), region=us-west2-edge, SDK=js@1.4.2

sam_oncall: I'm seeing a cluster of upstream_write_timeout and http2 window stalls for that trace_id on us-west2-edge-12. connection churn up about the time window size change landed (last week).

maria: can the customer reproduce with a minimal payload and stream=false? helps isolate streaming-only issues vs core model latency.

alex: customer tried minimal prompt (~2k chars) and still got 504 when using streaming. When they set stream=false they get 200 consistently. Their SDK auto-retries on 5xx immediately (no jitter) which causes a retry loop.

sam_oncall: provisional mitigation: enable streaming_fallback for this tenant to route streaming requests through chunked-transfer (drop h2 streaming path) while we investigate. also recommend the customer enable exponential backoff in their SDK.

ci-bot: deploy scheduled: apply config patch cfg-789 -> tenant tidalapps (streaming_fallback=true). rollout: canary -> 25% -> 100%. started at 08:28 UTC, ETA ~90s.

maria: digging into root cause — signs point to an h2 write window regression interacting with our ingress proxy under bursty client writes. h2 window shrink + client-side small writes causes upstream stalls. reproducing in staging now with h2 window sim.

alex: customer comms sent: "We temporarily routed your streaming requests to a fallback path to avoid the 5xx while we investigate. Please avoid immediate retries for 2 minutes to let traffic calm down; we'll confirm when it's resolved."

sam_oncall: canary looks good at 25%, error rate for this tenant dropped to baseline. pushing to 100% now.

ci-bot: deploy complete: cfg-789 -> 100% applied for tenant tidalapps at 08:31:50 UTC.

maria: follow-up action items: 1) revert/adjust h2 window tuning in next edge rollout, 2) add server-side guard to reject immediate retry loops per tenant, 3) add a targeted test for streaming write window behavior.

alex: filing postmortem / incident ticket and looping in customer success for formal update.

sam_oncall: created INC-2026-233 and attached logs/traces. tagging infra and runtime teams.

alex: will close thread after CS confirms customer satisfied. :thumbsup:
